text:
tara: quick post - ran cross-region KV cache sensitivity bench for a new model bring-up. seqlen mix used: 25% short(8), 50% mid(128), 25% long(768). results + traces: https://internal.corp/redwood/bench/1799991234
kevin: good context. prefetch on or off? eviction policy?
lucy: and which kernels/driver builds per region? those matter for host reads.
tara: ran 4 variants: prefetch=on/off x eviction=lru/base vs lru/large-window. kernels: us-east (h100) built with gcc-12+jit-v3, eu-west (h100) same, ap-sg (a100) image used distro-default gcc-9 + jit-v1 (we later rebuild).
ci-bot: perf job queued: bench/1799991234 • env=staging-like • concurrency=48
tara: paste of top-line med/p99 token latency (ms) and cache hit-rate (by region, prefetch=on, default-window):
```
us-east (h100) prefetch=on, default: med=0.75ms, p99=22ms, hit=0.91
eu-west (h100) prefetch=on, default: med=0.9ms, p99=30ms, hit=0.88
ap-sg (a100) prefetch=on, default: med=1.9ms, p99=220ms, hit=0.76
```
kevin: ap-sg p99 is huge. looks like host fetch spikes. did you capture per-token host-read traces?
tara: yes - snippets show PCIe/host-read stalls aligned with long-seq requests and with eviction churn. extracted trace:
```
[2026-05-02T03:21:17Z] kv_cache: miss -> schedule_page_fetch(1MB) latency=64ms
[2026-05-02T03:21:17Z] dma_engine: pci_read stall 58ms
[2026-05-02T03:21:17Z] eviction: reclaim 4MB blocks triggered by large-window=false
```
lucy: two hypotheses: (1) A100 image used older kernel/toolchain causing different allocator behavior, (2) NIC bandwidth or host CPU saturation for page handling.
joel: did you try prefetch=off?
tara: yes. switching prefetch=off reduced ap-sg p99 by ~40% in the immediate run (med ~1.7ms, p99 ~132ms) but hit-rate dropped to 0.69. tradeoff is fewer host stalls but more misses = more compute tokens.
kevin: interesting. what about increasing local kv page size or enlarging LRU window to reduce eviction churn?
tara: we ran page_size=512KB and lru-window=4MB in a follow-up on ap-sg with prefetch=off: med=1.6ms, p99=95ms, hit=0.82. so bigger window helps but doesn't fix toolchain-induced host-read cost.
perf-bot: generated charts uploaded: https://internal.corp/redwood/bench/1799991234/charts (hit-rate vs median/p99 by seqlen bucket) :bar_chart:
kevin: good. actionable summary?
lucy: propose region defaults: for A100 regions with older kernel/toolchain -> prefetch=off, lru-window=3-4MB, page_size=512KB, enable direct-io if supported. for H100 regions keep prefetch=on, default-window.
joel: runtime change: add a kernel-health detector that watches host_read latency >40ms sustained over 3m and auto-apply the A100-safe config and emit alert.
tara: agreed. action items:
- tara: upload full CSV + perf traces to bench folder (done)
- kevin: re-run ap-sg with rebuilt image (gcc-12 + jit-v3) and page_size=256KB, prefetch=on/off comparison (ETA 18h)
- lucy: draft region default config PR for runtime (include detection rule)
- joel: add perf alert and make fallback toggle in runtime
ci-bot: perf run completed: bench/1799991234 • artifacts: uploaded
tara: thanks all. i'll add a short note to the model-onboarding doc (kv-cache region guidance + required kernel checks) and ping @infra for image rollout coordination.
